newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rouen Jan 1-22 flour exports reach 69,933 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Rouen Jan 1-22 flour exports reach 69,933 tonnes.

text.p: Flour exports from Rouen reached 69,933 tonnes between January 1 and January 22, port officials said on Tuesday.
Flour exports totalled 97,000 tonnes in the whole of January 1996.
January 1-22 exports included 21,254 tonnes for Yemen, 21,720 tonnes for west Africa, 16,459 tonnes for Egypt and 10,500 tonnes for Sudan.
One ship was also loading 6,000 tonnes of flour at Rouen, officials said. The flour was destined for west Africa.
